title: KubeCon 2026 - travel & expense / booth logistics scratchpad
content:
Quick notes + checklist for KubeCon NA 2026 (Seattle) - personal/admin scratchpad. Mostly things to remember for expenses, receipts, booth handoffs, vendor contacts, and travel reimbursements.

Key dates:
- Conference: 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13 (expo Tues-Thu)
- Booth move-in: 2026-03-09 08:00-18:00 (arrive early)
- Booth teardown: 2026-03-13 17:00-22:00
- Slides upload deadline (talk): 2026-03-08 23:59 PT

Flight / hotel (my bookings):
- Flight (round-trip): SFO -> SEA (Alaska Airlines AS123 / AS456)
  - Departure: 2026-03-09 06:30, Return: 2026-03-14 20:15
  - Keep boarding passes + e-ticket PDF for reimbursement
- Hotel: Grand Hyatt Seattle (confirmation: 987654321)
  - Check-in 3/09 after 15:00, check-out 3/14 11:00
  - Use corporate rate (code REDWOOD_CORP) - incidentals on personal card, submit itemized receipt if charged

Expense reminders (T&E):
- Policy highlights: daily meal cap $75 (Seattle). All meals >$25 require receipt. Alcohol separated and must be reasonable on business card approvals.
- Always upload receipts to Ramp / Concur within 7 days of expense.
- Company card use: preferred for hotel and booth shipping. If personal card used, tag as reimbursement and include bank last4 and receipt scan.
- Receipt thresholds: any single expense >$75 needs manager note; receipts required for all transactions.
- Currency: all USD for Seattle.

Expense categories (how I'll code):
- AIRFARE: travel-air
- HOTEL: travel-lodging
- GROUND: travel-ground (Uber/Lyft/taxi)
- MEALS: travel-meals
- BOOTH_SHIPPING: events-shipping
- AV & RENTALS: events-av
- PROMO: events-marketing

Receipt checklist (what I scan):
- Boarding passes (PDF)
- E-ticket + price breakdown for airfare
- Hotel folio (must show nightly rates + taxes)
- Uber receipts with map where possible (or credit card statement if missing)
- FedEx/shipping receipts (tracking + invoice)
- AV/invoice from local vendor (itemized)
- Catering/booth meal receipts if > $75 total (split code if internal team meals)

Booth logistics / vendor contacts:
- Booth builder / drayage: Pacific Expo Services (account: Redwood23)
  - Contact: Maria Gonzalez, maria@pacificexpo.com, +1-206-555-0142
  - Move-in instructions, flooring/riser dims: ask for final floor plan by 3/03
- AV company: SoundStage AV
  - Contact: Ben Cho, ben@soundstageav.com, +1-206-555-0199
  - Confirm mics (2 lav + 1 handheld), 1 confidence monitor, HDMI switcher
- Shipping / FedEx: Redwood corporate FedEx acct (acct # on Confluence page)
  - Drop-off date target: by 2026-03-05 to meet exhibitor deadline
  - Tracking must be attached to expense submission or events will mark as vendor-paid
- Promo materials (swag): Red enamel pins + stickers + 500 postcards shipped
  - Vendor: PrintHive (PO# 1122) - contact: Raj Patel, raj@printhive.com

Staffing / schedule (booth):
- Mon 3/09 - setup: Chris (lead), Alex, Jordan arrive early (08:00)
- Tue 3/10 - expo day 1: 09:00-17:30 shifts: Chris (09-12), Samantha (12-15), Alex (15-18)
- Wed 3/11 - expo day 2: Chris (09-13), Jordan (13-17)
- Thu 3/12 - expo day 3: conference wrap / demos: rotating 09-14; teardown Thu 17:00 onward
- Important: ensure someone has the exhibitor badge scanner and phone with PowerShare battery at all times

Talk / session notes (if presenting):
- Title: "Reducing inference cost with intelligent batching & KV caching" (30 min)
- AV needs: laptop HDMI, 2 mics. Bring USB-C adapter and local backup on my laptop + slide PDF on USB + uploaded to speaker site.
- Slide checklist: speaker notes cleared, company branding slide (legal ok), no logos from partners without permission.

Reimbursements & quick templates (copy into Concur):
- Describe travel reason exactly: "KubeCon NA 2026 - Booth staffing and product demos; speaking session on inference optimization."
- Expense memo example: "Flight AS123 $312.34 - personal cc last4 1234 - reimbursable per travel policy. Hotel Grand Hyatt (folio attached). Uber 3/10 - airport -> hotel $37.62."

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
- Confirm final floor plan from Pacific Expo by 3/03 - action: Jordan to chase (JIRA KUBE-234 assigned).
- Who has the company badge pickup authorization? Need name on exhibitor portal for badge pickup (Slack thread #events-kubecon).
- Confirm whether catering for booth staff is allowed on events budget (Samantha check with finance).
- Double-check AV quote vs. Concur allowed vendors (Ben to confirm line items).

Post-conference follow-ups:
- Ship back any borrowed gear (AV cables, stands) using FedEx overnight and file shipping expense under events-shipping.
- Upload all receipts + photo of hotel folio to Concur by 2026-03-21 (2 weeks after travel).
- Retro notes: quick Slack postmortem in #events-kubecon within 3 business days after return.

Notes to self (misc):
- Print 10 business cards to hand out; carry a few extra chargers + powerstrip for demos.
- Bring ethernet adapter (conference Wi-Fi might be flaky).
- Keep one copy of badge QR printed in case phone dies.

Contacts summary: (copy to phone)
- Maria Gonzalez, Pacific Expo: +1-206-555-0142, maria@pacificexpo.com
- Ben Cho, SoundStage AV: +1-206-555-0199, ben@soundstageav.com
- Raj Patel, PrintHive: raj@printhive.com

End of scratchpad. Will iterate after Jordan/Sam update floor plan and AV quote.

Quick versions history:
- 2026-02-19: initial notes + bookings
- 2026-02-25: added booth staffing plan
- 2026-03-04: aligned expense codes + added FedEx reminder
